rotation_scenarios.scenario: OpenAI key leaked in public repo
steps: Generate new key in OpenAI dashboard
Update Vault with new key via rotate_secret()
Verify all services picked up new key
Revoke old key in OpenAI dashboard
Old key remains valid for 24 hours (blue-green)

rotation_scenarios.action: Rotate all secrets accessed by employee
steps: Audit Vault logs for secret access by employee
Identify all secrets accessed in last 90 days
Rotate each secret via batch rotation

rotation_race_condition.root_cause: In-flight requests using old key after rotation
rotation_race_condition.fix: Implement request tracking with grace period

vault_connection_failure.root_cause: Vault server unavailable or token invalid
vault_connection_failure.prevention: Monitor Vault health separately, implement retry logic

stale_cache.symptom: Services using old secrets after rotation
stale_cache.root_cause: LRU cache not invalidated after rotation
stale_cache.prevention: Use cache versioning or pub/sub invalidation

git_leak.symptom: Secret found in git history after deletion

environment_conflict.root_cause: Local env vars shadowing deployment config
environment_conflict.prevention: Explicit environment checks, separate Vault namespaces

large_scale.note: Consider Vault Enterprise ($4500/year) or managed service
